feature: Batch 4 — marketplace (28 real routes: merchant-brand, price, review) — real Playwright-driven API validation, RISK-017 live cross-tenant proof, RBAC matrix

steps.title: Real login for super_admin + 2 plain seller identities, real EdDSA-signed tokens from the real identity service
steps.expected: All 3 real logins succeed
steps.actual: admin token present: true; seller-a: playwright-e2e-test-seller-a@askabd-dev.local; seller-b: playwright-e2e-test-seller-b@askabd-dev.local

steps.title: Real fixture: 1 category + 1 item created for price/offer/review testing
steps.expected: Both created (201)

steps.title: Real merchant registration for two distinct, unrelated identities (own resources — ALLOWED case)
steps.expected: Both 201

steps.title: RISK-017.1: seller A registers a merchant claiming tenantId=seller-org-b (not their own real org) — real, live proof, not assumed
steps.expected: Per RISK-017 (OPEN, not fixed): the claimed tenantId is persisted unchecked against the caller's real identity
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB tenant_id for the created row: seller-org-b (claimed: seller-org-b, real caller: seller-org-a)
steps.notes: PASS_WITH_RISKS status here means the KNOWN OPEN vulnerability was successfully, independently reproduced — matches expected per RISK-017, not a new finding. A plain PASS would mean it was unexpectedly fixed (also reported honestly, not assumed).

steps.title: RISK-017.2: seller A submits a verification document for merchant B (owned by seller B) — real, live cross-tenant mutation attempt
steps.expected: Per RISK-017 (OPEN): no ownership check on :id, real mutation persisted despite the caller having no real relationship to merchant B
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB row exists for merchant_id=6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d (expected merchantB=6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d)
steps.notes: Real, live reproduction of a documented OPEN risk — not a new finding.

steps.title: RISK-017.3: seller A adds a branch to merchant B — real, live cross-tenant mutation attempt
steps.expected: Per RISK-017 (OPEN): no ownership check, real branch persisted under merchant B despite being created by an unrelated identity
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB row merchant_id=6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d (expected merchantB=6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d)
steps.notes: Real, live reproduction of a documented OPEN risk — not a new finding.

steps.title: RBAC: non-admin seller identity DENIED on POST /admin/merchants/:id/approve
steps.expected: 403 — Merchant.Approve required, no seller has it
steps.actual: Real HTTP 403

steps.title: RBAC: real super_admin ALLOWED on POST /admin/merchants/:id/approve, real DB status change verified
steps.expected: 200/201, real status change from the denied attempt's pre-state
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200. Real DB status: before=pending, after=active

steps.title: RBAC: unauthenticated DENIED on admin-gated route
steps.actual: Real HTTP 401

steps.title: RBAC: non-admin seller DENIED on POST /admin/brands
steps.expected: 403 — Admin.Access required
steps.actual: Real HTTP 403

steps.title: RBAC: real super_admin ALLOWED on POST /admin/brands, real DB row created
steps.expected: 201, real row exists
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB row: {"id":"6ce411f1-1f33-4347-91b5-4dd465d20698","name":"Batch4 Brand 1788109771078"}

steps.title: RBAC: non-admin seller DENIED on GET /admin/reviews/pending (moderation queue)
steps.actual: Real HTTP 403

steps.title: Genuinely public-shaped read route: unauthenticated still DENIED (401)
steps.expected: 401 — requires SOME real authenticated identity, matching a real shopper-facing marketplace
steps.actual: Real HTTP 401

steps.title: Genuinely public-shaped read route: any authenticated identity (no special role) ALLOWED
steps.expected: 200 — any authenticated shopper can browse prices
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200

steps.title: Real price creation for own merchant (real DB row verified)
steps.expected: 201, real row with correct merchant_id + price

steps.title: RISK-017 extension: seller A creates a real price record attributed to merchant B (not tested in the prior audit — checked fresh this pass, per directive)
steps.expected: Real, observed result (may or may not share the same ownership gap as merchant/verification/branch — not assumed either way)
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB row merchant_id: 6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d (expected if unchecked: 6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d)
steps.notes: Real, live finding: this same class of gap extends to price records too (consistent with POST /prices having no ownership check per the route's own RBAC rule, authenticatedOnly).

steps.title: Real offer creation for own merchant (real DB row verified)
steps.expected: 201, real row
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB row: {"id":"25cd5dac-c968-4311-8b97-38bc00e08292","merchant_id":"6b6d4ea1-3ecd-4ae2-b16d-54d90ba8f73d","title":"Batch4 Real Offer"}

steps.title: RISK-017.4: seller A posts a review attributed to an arbitrary, unrelated userId (not their own real identity) — real, live proof
steps.expected: Per RISK-017 (OPEN): review.user_id is trusted from the request body with zero verification against the caller's real identity
steps.actual: Real HTTP 201. Real DB user_id: aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee (claimed/spoofed: aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee, real caller identityId: 0a557c58-1359-4397-9d40-5a56de338840)
steps.notes: Real, live reproduction of a documented OPEN risk — not a new finding.

steps.title: Genuinely public-shaped read: seller B (unrelated identity) can see the review just created by seller A — confirms the intentional public-read shape, not tenant-isolated by design
steps.expected: Real 200, the review appears in the real list
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200, spoofed review present: true

steps.title: Real search: GET /items?search=Batch4 finds the real fixture item
steps.expected: Real 200, the real item appears in real results
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200, real item found: true, 1 result(s)

steps.title: Real search: a genuinely non-matching query returns a real empty result, not an error or fabricated data
steps.expected: Real 200, empty items array
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200, 0 result(s)

steps.title: Real filter: GET /items?categoryId=<real id> finds the real fixture item
steps.expected: Real 200, real item present
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200, real item found: true

steps.title: Security: a real, well-formed but non-existent merchant id — safe error, no stack trace/secrets
steps.expected: A real, safe 4xx (400/404), never a 500 or a raw stack trace
steps.actual: Real HTTP 400. Body: {"error":{"category":"validation","code":"SHARED.VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"Referenced resource does not exist","statusCode":400}}

steps.title: Security: a malformed (non-UUID) merchant id — safe error, no stack trace
steps.expected: A real, safe 4xx, never a 500 or leaked internals
steps.actual: Real HTTP 400. Body: {"error":{"category":"validation","code":"invalid_merchant_id","field":"merchantId","message":"merchantId must be a valid UUID","statusCode":400}}

steps.title: Form validation: real duplicate slug rejected
steps.expected: A real 4xx conflict/validation error, not a silently-overwritten or duplicated row
steps.actual: Real HTTP 400. Body: {"error":{"category":"conflict","code":"slug_exists","message":"Merchant with this slug exists","statusCode":409}}

steps.title: Form validation: required fields missing
steps.expected: Real 400, safe validation error
steps.actual: Real HTTP 400. Body: {"error":{"category":"validation","code":"name_slug_required","message":"name and slug required","statusCode":400}}

steps.title: GET /brands + GET /brands/:slug — real list + real detail lookup
steps.expected: Real 200 for both, real fixture brand found by slug
steps.actual: list status=200 (1 results); by-slug status=200

steps.title: GET /merchants + GET /merchants/:id — real list + real detail lookup
steps.expected: Real 200 for both, real fixture merchant found
steps.actual: list status=200; by-id status=200, name=Batch4 Merchant A 1788109771078

steps.title: GET /items/:itemId/offers + GET /offers/trending
steps.expected: Real 200 for both; the real fixture offer appears in the item-scoped list
steps.actual: item-offers status=200 (1 results); trending status=200

steps.title: GET /items/:itemId/prices/lowest + /prices/merchants
steps.expected: Real 200 for both
steps.actual: lowest status=200, price=1; merchants status=200

steps.title: GET /items/:itemId/reviews/stats + POST /reviews/:id/helpful (real DB increment verified)
steps.expected: Real 200 for stats; real 204 for helpful vote, real DB helpful_count incremented
steps.actual: stats status=200; helpful status=204, real DB helpful_count=1

steps.title: POST /admin/merchants/:id/suspend — real super_admin action, real DB status change verified
steps.expected: Real 200/201, real status change
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200. Real DB status: before=active, after=suspended

steps.title: POST /admin/verifications/:id/review — real super_admin decision, real DB status change verified
steps.expected: Real 200, real status now "approved"
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200. Real DB status: approved

steps.title: PUT /admin/brands/:id + POST .../archive + POST .../restore — real DB status transitions verified
steps.expected: Real 2xx for all 3; real DB status changes to archived then back
steps.actual: update status=200; archive status=204 (DB status after: archived); restore status=204 (DB status after: active)

steps.title: POST /admin/reviews/:id/moderate — real super_admin moderation decision, real DB status verified — the 28th and final real marketplace route
steps.expected: Real 200, real status reflects the decision
steps.actual: Real HTTP 200. Real DB status: active
